blurb.en: The same cut, two completely different dishes. Pick by how much time you have and what equipment you own.
blurb.es: El mismo corte, dos platos completamente distintos. Elegí según el tiempo que tengas y el equipo que tengás.

summary.en: Low and slow on the smoker. Twelve hours of patience for twenty minutes of dinner.
summary.es: Bajo y lento en el ahumador. Doce horas de paciencia para veinte minutos de cena.

summary.en: Braised in stock and tomato in a covered pot. About four hours start to finish, no smoker, no fire management.
summary.es: Braseado en caldo y tomate en olla tapada. Unas cuatro horas de principio a fin, sin ahumador y sin manejar fuego.

note_to_build: Two variants exist from day one. This is why categories are structural rather than added later — a flat recipe list would have needed every brisket URL rewritten at recipe three.
